action: Begin scanning with the probe oriented in the transverse plane.
Immediately assess the lower uterine segment to identify the presenting part.
interpretation: Visualize the fetal head positioned down (cephalic presentation). Identify the echogenic skull bones.

action: Initiate a sweep to determine fetal lie and orientation.
interpretation: Prepare to track the fetal body to establish position relative to the maternal axis.

action: Slide the probe superiorly along the maternal right side.
interpretation: Scan up the maternal right flank to trace the fetal body.

action: Identify the fetal back on the right side. Visualize the thorax.
interpretation: Confirm the fetal spine is located to the maternal right. visualize the fetal heart beating nicely.

action: Sweep the probe across the fundus ('the top') and curve around to follow the fetal anatomy.
interpretation: Locate the fetal buttocks ('bum') at the fundus (bum up). Visualize the hip bones and legs.

action: Maintain probe position in the upper quadrant and correlate findings with patient symptoms.
interpretation: Note that fetal limbs in the upper quadrant correspond to the patient feeling 'lots of kicks' in this area.

action: Adjust the scanning plane to isolate and evaluate the placenta.
interpretation: Transition focus to assess placental location.

action: Identify the placental margin. Slide the probe superiorly ('scanning up') to trace the placental body.
interpretation: Visualize the placental edge. Confirm the placenta is definitely anterior. Verify that the placenta does not appear to be low-lying.
